title: the 301 un-derivable counts whose face already publishes their unit were handed on as 'move the count' -- how many of those moves exist, where they would land, and how many would agree with the list they land beside
no_bill: measurement only: the dated BAND faces are re-read and their own published counts, lists and scopes are compared. No draw stream is drawn, no band rebuilt, no engine runs, no verdict about the market. A verdict here is a statement about a proposed edit to a published face.

universe_vintage.rule: a face re-derives against the universe that existed when it published; only a new run widens it, and that run publishes a new stamp

frozen_spec.D1_plan_from_faces_census_from_e286: which counts are un-derivable is imported from the census; scopes, lengths and values are read off the published face; the plan also joins E290's 301-row / 299-scope headline
frozen_spec.D2_premise_checked: a row is moveable only when a list of exactly the claimed unit exists in the same face and resolves to a list; failures published
frozen_spec.D3_agreement_measured_with_its_scope: the published value is compared to the candidate list's length AND the scope relation is published, so an agreement in an unrelated subtree is its own bucket with its degenerate-target share
frozen_spec.D4_unique_and_collision_free: more than one candidate scope is a choice; a target scope already holding the key is a mirror (same value) or a collision (different value)
frozen_spec.D5_rank_by_gain_per_move: per-face ranking key is related-scope clean counts / distinct target scopes, then foreign agreements, then convictions, then face name
frozen_spec.D6_no_reburn: published faces re-read only; no draw stream, no band rebuild, no engine

vocab_amendment.when: after the first build of this face, before the face was published or wired
vocab_amendment.why: the first build scored agreement without asking where the candidate list lives and reported 126 clean moves / 75 convictions; a relation-aware recount showed all 126 agreements sit in unrelated subtrees against lists of at most one item, and no row lands beside a list in its own scope, which the four declared verdicts could not express
vocab_amendment.kept: the four original verdicts are unchanged and remain reachable; V4 names the case the declaration missed rather than reinterpreting a clean result

summary.shape_statement: move_count = qualified key + exactly one list of that unit; move_count is only 'clean' when the list lives in the count's own scope or a scope that contains / sits under it -- an agreement in a foreign scope is published as coincidence-prone; choice_required = the unit is published in more than one scope; needs_own_records = the key IS the unit name, so no sibling list of that name can exist; mirror_copy / collision = the target scope already holds this key with the same / a different value; premise_fails = no list of the claimed unit resolves in this face

verdict_reason: of 301 un-derivable 'elsewhere scope' counts in 32 face(s): 24 are bare unit-name rows with no relocation at all, 76 need a choice between scopes, 201 have a single target, 0 mirror or collide with a key already in the target scope, and 0 have no resolvable list of their unit; among the 201 single-target rows 126 agree with their candidate list and 75 do not, but only 0 of those rows land beside a list in their own scope or a scope that contains / sits under it -- 126 of the 126 agreements are against a list holding at most one item in an unrelated subtree, so the premise 'the face already publishes this unit where the count needs it' fails and the counts measure a collection the face never enumerates
